blur.$description: WARNING — `--blur-*` IS a Tailwind v4 theme namespace, so these OVERRIDE the built-ins: changing a value here changes every blur-* and backdrop-blur-* utility in the system. The values below match Tailwind v4's defaults EXACTLY (verified against tailwindcss/theme.css), so adopting the tokens is a no-op today. Tailwind's 2xl (40px) and 3xl (64px) are deliberately not restated — nothing uses them and they keep working from the defaults.

sm.$description: The dialog/popover scrim (`backdrop-blur-sm`) — the only blur in the system today.
